svg.text: The object graph of a .UTSCH design — the classes and the references between them
Every reference is a PTR, or a list or map of them (§3.2). Many objects are referred to from several places; each is written in full once, at its first reference, and as a reference after that.
Document body (§6), in stream order — each item holds objects of the class named
one per place a net name appears
the undo history; a reader skips it
no references but a text's font
every text refers to one CSerialFont
number labels → CUcText, one per gate
A line joins two classes whose objects refer to one another or one to the other; the rows of the boxes give the fields: "field → class" is one reference, "×n" a list or map of them.
Only references are shown; the other fields of each class are in the section named. Texts and attributes occur in almost every class and their lines are left out.
Blue: a CSheet continues as a complete CSymbol, its frame (§8); the subsheet box a parent shows is that symbol's part (§8.2).
